description: Regression gate for compose-target double-allocation bug. AddScreen triggers ensureScreenRenderTarget; if the show thread double-allocates on every tick before the editor acks the slot, the descriptor heap saturates, the GPU wedges, the engine posts DeviceLost and exits, and the show frame counter stalls. A healthy run posts ScreenRenderTargetAllocated on the first tick, the editor writes the slot back, and subsequent ticks take path-1 (no alloc). WaitUntilShowFrameCountAtLeast expresses the invariant directly: the counter either advances to 10 (healthy, passes as soon as it does regardless of machine speed) or stalls and the timeout fails the script (wedged). The old form -- SleepMs 200 then assert count >= 10 -- assumed 60 Hz show ticks and failed on slow WARP CI runners that present fewer than 10 frames in 200 ms.
